units.source_text: 一旦被別人惡言相向，我便覺得別人言之有理，都是自己的錯，總是默默地承受別人的攻擊，內心感到快要發瘋的恐懼。

en.t: Whenever someone spoke harshly to me, I immediately felt that they were right and that everything was my fault, so I silently endured their attacks while feeling a terror inside as if I were about to go mad.

units.source_text: 無論是誰，受人責備或訓斥時，心裡都會感到不是滋味，但我能從人們暴怒的臉上，發現比獅子、鱷魚、巨龍還要可怕的動物本性。

en.t: Anyone would feel miserable when blamed or scolded by others, but in people's faces when they flew into a rage, I could discern an animal nature more frightening than lions, crocodiles, or dragons.

units.source_text: 平常他們說不定都隱藏著這種本性，

en.t: Ordinarily, they may well keep that nature hidden,

units.source_text: 可一有機會，他們就像溫順地臥在地上歇息的牛，

en.t: but as soon as there is an opportunity, they are like a docile cow lying on the ground at rest,

units.source_text: 會突然甩動尾巴拍死肚皮上的牛虻一樣，

en.t: which suddenly flicks its tail and swats dead the gadfly on its belly,

units.source_text: 在暴怒中暴露出人可怕的本性。

en.t: and in their rage they expose the terrifying nature of human beings.

units.source_text: 看到這一幕，我總是嚇得渾身打戰。

en.t: Whenever I saw this, I was always so frightened that my whole body trembled.
